extension.summary: Every free and legal motorsport stream in one place
extension.description:
Motorsport Hub brings together every free and legal motorsport stream: live races, full replays, classics and shows from 96 official sources — Formula 1 classics, MotoGP, WEC and Le Mans, IMSA, GT World Challenge, DTM, Super GT, NASCAR, IndyCar, Formula E, WRC rally, rallycross, MXGP, Supercross, karting, drag racing and hill climbs.
Live Now shows every official channel streaming right now. This Weekend lists upcoming sessions in your own timezone. Spoiler-free by default: titles and thumbnails that give away results stay hidden until you press play.
No ads, no login, no piracy — the add-on only links to streams the rights holders publish themselves (official YouTube channels, free FAST channels and public archives). Nothing is hosted or re-streamed. Sources are health-checked daily.
YouTube playback requires the official YouTube add-on.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on does not host or provide any content. It links to streams published by the rights holders themselves on their own official channels.
